questions.question: What are the names of the teachers who are aged either 32 or 33?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM teacher WHERE Age  =  32 OR Age  =  33
questions.generated_sql: SELECT Name FROM teacher WHERE Age IN ('32', '33') LIMIT 500;

questions.question: What is the most commmon hometowns for teachers?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Hometown FROM teacher GROUP BY Hometown ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.generated_sql:
WITH hometown_counts AS (
  SELECT
    Hometown,
    COUNT(*) AS teacher_count
  FROM teacher
  GROUP BY Hometown
), max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(teacher_count) AS max_teacher_count
  FROM hometown_counts
)
SELECT
  hc.Hometown,
  hc.teacher_count
FROM hometown_counts AS hc
JOIN max_count AS mc
  ON hc.teacher_count = mc.max_teacher_count
ORDER BY hc.Hometown;

questions.question: What are the names of the teachers whose courses have not been arranged?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM teacher WHERE Teacher_id NOT IN (SELECT Teacher_id FROM course_arrange)
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT t.Name
FROM teacher AS t
LEFT JOIN course_arrange AS ca
  ON t.Teacher_ID = ca.Teacher_ID
WHERE ca.Teacher_ID IS NULL
ORDER BY t.Name
LIMIT 500;

questions.question: For each hometown, how many teachers are there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Hometown ,  COUNT(*) FROM teacher GROUP BY Hometown

questions.question: What is the age and hometown of every teacher?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Age ,  Hometown FROM teacher
questions.generated_sql: SELECT Age, Hometown FROM teacher LIMIT 500;

questions.generated_sql: SELECT Name, Country FROM singer WHERE Song_Name LIKE '%Hey%' LIMIT 500;

questions.question: Show all countries and the number of singers in each country.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT country ,  count(*) FROM singer GROUP BY country
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT singer.Country AS country, COUNT(*) AS singer_count
FROM singer
GROUP BY singer.Country

questions.question: Show names for all stadiums except for stadiums having a concert in year 2014.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM stadium EXCEPT SELECT T2.name FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.year  =  2014
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT s.Name
FROM stadium AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM concert AS c
    WHERE c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
      AND c.Year = '2014'
);

questions.question: What are the names and locations of the stadiums that had concerts that occurred in both 2014 and 2015?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name ,  T2.location FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.Year  =  2014 INTERSECT SELECT T2.name ,  T2.location FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.Year  =  2015
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT stadium.Name, stadium.Location
FROM stadium
JOIN concert ON concert.Stadium_ID = stadium.Stadium_ID
WHERE concert.Year IN ('2014', '2015')
GROUP BY stadium.Stadium_ID, stadium.Name, stadium.Location
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT concert.Year) = 2;

questions.question: Which year has most number of concerts?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT YEAR FROM concert GROUP BY YEAR ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT c.Year, COUNT(*) AS concert_count
FROM concert AS c
GROUP BY c.Year
ORDER BY concert_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What are the names and grades for each high schooler?

questions.question: What are the names of high schoolers who have 3 or more friends?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*)  >=  3

questions.question: Show ids of all students who do not have any friends.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT id FROM Highschooler EXCEPT SELECT student_id FROM Friend
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT h.ID
FROM Highschooler AS h
LEFT JOIN Friend AS f
  ON h.ID = f.student_id

questions.question: Show name of all students who have some friends and also are liked by someone else.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id INTERSECT SELECT T2.name FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.liked_id  =  T2.id

questions.question: Show the names of students who have at least 2 likes.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT h.name
FROM Highschooler AS h
JOIN Likes AS l ON h.ID = l.liked_id
GROUP BY h.ID, h.name
HAVING COUNT(l.student_id) >= 2;

questions.question: What are the major record formats of orchestras, sorted by their frequency?
